periods.summary: Toka does not appear directly in vol-02, but her status drives the epilogue. After Ikki defeats Kuraudo, students begin comparing the Worst One with Hagun's strongest student, Raikiri. At the same time Shizuku receives notice that her next selection opponent is Toka Todo, causing Shizuku to seek harder training and anticipate a serious fight.

key_events.summary: Named as Shizuku's next opponent and as Hagun's strongest student.

relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Defeats Shizuku in a B-rank duel while recognizing her courage.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Respects him as a knight; loses to his Ittou Rasetsu and later personally hands him the school flag.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Childhood friend from Wakaba Home and student council vice-president; he supports her anxieties.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Student council treasurer and old friend from Wakaba Home circles.

periods.summary: Toka dominates vol-03 as Hagun's strongest student. She defeats Shizuku by combining lightning magic, martial footwork, Reverse Sight and the unavoidable Raikiri. Off the battlefield she is a caring, clumsy, motherly student council president who knows many students by name, comes from Wakaba Home, cooks for others, and carries the hopes of orphanage children. She rescues Ikki and Stella from remote stone puppets during the Okutama investigation, then is forced by the Ethics Committee's scheme into becoming Ikki's final opponent. She initially hopes he will withdraw for his health, but when he appears she rejoices as a knight and meets his challenge head-on. Her best Raikiri is shattered by Ikki's Ittou Rasetsu. In the epilogue she accepts defeat with pride, resolves to grow stronger, and hands Ikki the Hagun flag during the representative ceremony.

key_events.summary: Defeats Shizuku without taking a decisive wound.
Identifies the wire-puppet hub and destroys the attackers with Raikiri.
Warns Shizuku that she may have to fight Ikki at full force.
Accepts Ikki's direct challenge to Raikiri and loses.
Hands the school flag to Ikki and asks him to carry the defeated fighters' wishes.

periods.occupation: student knight; student council president; training coach

status.current: unconscious after defending Hagun against Akatsuki
status.representative_status: not a Seven Stars representative this year but still one of Hagun's strongest fighters

personality.summary: Calm, dutiful and tactically mature; prioritizes preserving Hagun representatives over personal pride.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Camp sparring partner; teaches her that top fighters weaponize their own weaknesses, then later knocks her out to evacuate her from Ouma.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Cannot meaningfully injure him even with Raikiri and Takemikazuchi; is defeated by Kusanagi.
relationships.student-council: Leads them in a delaying action after evacuating Hagun's representatives.

periods.summary: Toka serves as a volunteer coach at the Yamagata camp and defeats Stella by baiting her counter to Raikiri, demonstrating the tactical level needed for national top fighters. During Akatsuki's assault she makes the key decision that Hagun's representatives must survive to keep Akatsuki from replacing Hagun at Seven Stars. She rescues Stella from Ouma's Kusanagi, stuns her, orders the Hagure sisters to flee with her, and remains with the student council to delay Akatsuki. Her Raikiri and unfinished Takemikazuchi fail to truly wound Ouma, and she is defeated by his Kusanagi.

key_events.summary: Defeats Stella and explains national-level baiting tactics.
Saves Stella from Ouma, forces her evacuation, and stays behind.
Falls after failing to pierce Ouma's defense.

periods.summary: Toka wakes in Hagun's hospital after the Akatsuki attack and learns that the student council only suffered Fantasy Form damage. She watches the Seven Stars broadcast with Kanata, worries at first about Stella's delayed match, then analyzes Ikki's first-round fight with Moroboshi. Because she has fought both men, she judges that Moroboshi is only slightly favored and explains Moroboshi's spear weaknesses and hidden strengths.

key_events.summary: Wakes in hospital and learns Stella's match was postponed.
Analyzes Ikki versus Moroboshi from the hospital broadcast.

status.current: hospitalized but awake enough to watch the Seven Stars broadcast with Kanata

personality.summary: Gracious and competitive; she is grateful for Stella's kindness, analyzes the tournament calmly, yet still regrets not fighting as a contestant herself.
fears: Stella being cornered by Akatsuki's matchup

relationships.stella-vermillion: Junior whose four-on-one challenge Touka understands as revenge for injured Hagun students.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Fellow student council member who wakes in the next bed and warns about Amane.

relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Hospital roommate/visitor who explains Tatara's reflection ability from experience.

periods.summary: Touka watches Stella's unprecedented four-on-one B-block match from her hospital room with Kanata. She understands Stella's motive: preventing Akatsuki representatives from avoiding punishment for the Hagun attack. Kanata's report lets Touka identify Tatara as a reflection mage and worry about the matchup. After Stella wins, Touka evaluates the tournament's remaining contenders, naming Stella, Ouma, Kiriko, Shizuku, Kaga and Ikki among possible champions, and admits she wishes she could have fought as a contestant. When Utakata wakes, Touka begins to explain the current situation, leading to his urgent warning about Amane.

key_events.summary: Learns from Kanata that Tatara's Complete Reflection makes her a terrible opponent for Stella.
Helps orient Utakata after he wakes, prompting his warning about Amane.

personality.summary: Dutiful and responsible even when frightened; tries to uphold student council obligations.

periods.summary: Toka appears in the ghost-story side episode after the selection battles. Although terrified by Utakata's and Kanata's stories, she insists on joining the search because she is the student council president. Paired with Stella, she uses electromagnetic sensing to confirm a bathroom has no human inside, but both are tricked by Kanata's projected ghost and flee screaming. She also helps explain the legal problem of dangerous special individual animals after the monkey is captured.

key_events.summary: Participates in the test-of-courage search and is scared by Kanata's projection.

periods.label: 见证后辈跨越自己的雷切

status.current: fully recovered from prior coma and supporting Ikki and Stella from the stands

personality.summary: Warm, perceptive, and honest about the awe she feels watching Stella and Ikki surpass earlier limits.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former opponent; she cheers him on and senses his grave resolve before the Amane match.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Junior she admires; she recognizes Stella's growth and later cheers both finalists.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Friend who attends the semifinals with her.

periods.summary: Toka arrives in Osaka with Kanata and Nene to watch the semifinals, fully recovered after having slept for a long time. She praises Stella's expression and notices how far Stella has advanced, later admitting that current Stella has grown beyond her own level. Before Ikki's semifinal she senses a heavy resolve in him similar to the day he arrived half-dead for their selection match. During Amane's heart-stop attack, Toka's sensitivity to body electrical signals lets her recognize Ikki's heart stopping before most spectators understand the danger. She also appears among the supporters waiting for the delayed Ikki-Stella final.

key_events.summary: Watches Stella's growth and Ouma's abnormal defenses.
Recognizes Ikki's heart stoppage and supports his advance.
Cheers both Ikki and Stella after the final is rescheduled.
